basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Practice card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, bold silhouettes, monumental environmental scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large calm color masses, and the sharpest contrast only at the action. Early twentieth-century adventure book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. Include two or three working human figures; all faces completely indiscernible, shown from behind, distant, or in deep shadow. Put the action, key tool or material, and principal figures in the UPPER CENTRAL 45 percent because game UI covers the lower half. The lower half is subdued and quiet. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter, or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.copyingTexts: In an immense shadowed scriptorium, three faceless hooded copyists work in a line of sloped desks. One gloved hand copies a broad illuminated page with a quill, the pale page the clear focal plane; other figures recede under tall arched windows. No readable marks on pages, warm ivory and dark blue.
assets.teaching: In a vast stone teaching hall, a cloaked teacher seen only from behind raises a long pointer toward one simple geometric wooden model while two hooded pupils watch. The model catches the single warm light; high columns make the group small. No writing, diagrams, visible faces, or modern classroom objects.
assets.scholarship: Three hooded scholars confer around one enormous open volume on a tall lectern beneath a vaulted hall. One scholar lifts a small blue crystal or glass lens above the page, and its pale reflection is the focal accent. A second holds the book, a third approaches through shadow; no readable writing.
assets.surveying: On a sweeping mountain ridge, three tiny cloaked surveyors measure a straight line across a chasm. One braces a tall wooden tripod sight in the upper center, another holds a distant rod, and a taut rope links them. The pale measuring line against dark valley is focal; huge landscape conveys scale.
assets.cartography: Within a high stone map room, three hooded cartographers spread a single enormous blank parchment map across a table. One gloved hand traces a bold coastline with ink while the others hold the sheet; the sweeping dark coastline and pale paper are focal. Vast window and shelves subordinate, no legible labels.
assets.astronomy: On a high observatory platform beneath an immense deep-blue star sky, three small cloaked astronomers align a great brass sighting instrument toward one bright moon. The angled instrument and moon make a strong diagonal; parapet and vast heavens dominate. Faces hidden, no astrological symbols.
assets.forecasting: Three faceless weather watchers stand on a monumental cliff tower as a storm advances across the valley. One grips a large iron weather vane at the instant it swings into the wind; a narrow lightning glint outlines the vane. Cloaks pull in the gale, landscape vast; storm slate and one pale accent.
assets.printing: In a vast timber press room, three hooded printers operate one heavy wooden screw press. The lead worker pulls its long lever while another lifts a fresh blank ivory sheet from the platen; this crisp rectangle is the focal shape. Huge dark beams and a few broad stacks recede. No text on paper.
assets.alchemy: Inside a cavernous stone laboratory, three cloaked alchemists tend one large sealed glass vessel. A small emerald transformation glows at the center as one pours from a copper ladle and the others brace the apparatus. Broad dark architectural shadows, one controlled green light; no glyphs or readable labels.
assets.ossuaryKeeping: In a towering underground ossuary, three hooded caretakers carefully place one pale skull and long bones into a high stone niche; the raised white bone is the focal accent. Vast dark arches and ordered shadowed alcoves make them tiny. Solemn, respectful, no gore or visible faces.
